status: Exploratory coverage specification fixed before this count; not preregistered or independently adjudicated
question: For reviewed decisions directly changing legal abortion access, which general legal-access survey questions have observations in an earlier year?
case_universe: Union of the two existing abortion case reviews, not search hits. This is an incomplete reviewed frame, not the universe of SCOTUS abortion cases.
case_rule: Include provisionally reviewed direct-access merits with protective or restrictive access_direction in primary coverage; list mixed and direct-access-plus-funding decisions separately. Prefer the more specific historical category when a later broad scope merges categories. Conflicting directions stop the count. Do not use SCDB ideology or vote margin as access impact.
survey_rule: Report each question separately. These ask broad legality or personal-choice access; they are not interchangeable measures. Never pool scores or interpret all midpoints as majority support. Keep ANES versions and CES scale versus binary items separate, including overlapping years.

timing.rule: Latest available observation for each question strictly before the decision calendar year, at most five years old; no same-year observations or interpolation.

output: Case-by-question availability table with explicit missing matches, distinct question-years and case counts. No alignment or prediction metric.
interpretation: A temporal match is contextual coverage, not an adjudicated exact-policy comparison. Each case still needs policy-component/holding matching to question wording and response categories. Existing annual fields are treated as survey years; fieldwork metadata and historical release dates remain to verify.
stop: Finish specification and coverage count only; no new models, search changes, deployment, or automatic expansion.
